hypothesis: A named cross-instance operation must not depend on unrelated destination declaration slots. Swapping adjacent independent scalar initializations preserves the complete host oracle while changing the representation layout.

tests.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_guest_declaration_order.py tests/test_checked_carrier_inverse.py tests/test_checked_carrier_search.py tests/test_relation_search_go_ts.py tests/test_candidate_edit_transport.py

policy: Uniform source generator across all 17 trials; source order; first controlled failure then one repeat; exact transport and passing source controls; no post-audit candidate replacement.
novelty: The contribution hypothesis concerns representation-sensitive cross-instance behavior. Declaration commutation is an existing means of testing that property, not a novelty claim by itself.
limitations: The small lexical guest grammar does not prove arbitrary program equivalence.
The source must establish a callable guest factory and named runtime access on the same construction path.
The current single-consumption helper summary rejects void drivers that reuse and wrap the guest program.
Native failure still requires independent review of the complete transformed host test and public contract.
All benchmark tasks have already influenced development.
The candidate fails at bc.Call before later source-isolation checks; those later expectations have a static contract derivation, not an observed dynamic pass.
Two passing P5 candidates retain original oracle ambiguities about cross-root aliasing and callable argument transfer. They emitted no alert and establish no semantic correctness.
root_cause: Transferred compiled functions retain numeric global-slot operands but use the destination global array. Independent destination declaration order changes the slot-to-name mapping. The source test originally places the referenced global at the same slot in both instances.
decision: Retain the new relation for a uniform combined-method evaluation. Standalone gain is one newly verified trial; do not add it to the best score before freezing and verifying the complete combination.
